Haryana Signs MoUs for Waste-to-Energy Projects

Haryana has signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with OIL Green Energy for four waste-to-clean energy projects. These projects are planned for Hisar, Ambala, Faridabad, and Gurugram. The proposed capacities are 500 tonnes per day (TPD) in Hisar, 900 TPD in Ambala, 1,600 TPD in Faridabad, and 2,000 TPD in Gurugram. The total capacity across these projects is 5,000 TPD, with a target of generating 50 MW of power.
